svg.title: CP/M banked memory: two banks, one Z80 address window
svg.desc: Schematic, not-to-scale memory map. Bank 0 has a 58,624-byte transient program area; bank 1 has a 50,944-byte fixed-address DCC library region. Each region shows separate image/BSS, malloc heap and call stack blocks with a 512-byte call stack example. In each bank, the image (code, DCC runtime and initialized data) and BSS occupy 0100h through that bank's heap_base minus one. The illustrative bank-0 heap ends at E3FFh and its stack occupies E400h through E5FFh, reserving the top 512 bytes of the TPA. The bank-1 heap ends at C5FFh and its stack occupies C600h through C7FFh. Actual bank-0 placement is application-specific; the bank-1 stack budget comes from the LIB header. Bank 0 also holds page zero, CCP, the BDOS shim and BIOS. Bank 1 also holds page zero, a separate 5,632-byte allocation pool, resident services, allocator, authoritative BDOS and BIOS. Both banks contain the FB40h trampoline and FF00h gateway. OUT 07h selects A16 from D0 in PIO1. Checked copied transfers and synchronous calls restore the caller's bank and stack; pointers do not cross banks. BSS means Block Started by Symbol: RAM for zero-initialized global and static variables. The bank-1 library loader clears BSS before use; heap_base follows the image and BSS.
svg.text: CP/M memory: two banks, one address window
128 KiB SRAM | Z80 sees 0000h-FFFFh | A16 selects one complete 64 KiB bank
Addresses are hexadecimal. Region heights are schematic, not proportional to capacity.
BANK 0 | CP/M host | A16 = 0
BANK 1 | Resident services | A16 = 1
0000h-00FFh | Page zero
0000h: warm boot | 0005h: BDOS shim | FCBs / DMA
0000h-00FFh | Page zero
0005h: bank-1 BDOS | library's local CP/M vectors
0100h-E5FFh | Transient Program Area (TPA)
58,624 bytes total
0100h-(heap_base-1) | .COM image + BSS
Code + DCC runtime + initialized data + BSS
heap_base-E3FFh | malloc heap
512-byte stack example; heap size depends on image + BSS
E400h-E5FFh | Call stack (512-byte example)
Grows down; example reservation below E600h
0100h-C7FFh | Fixed-address DCC library region
50,944 bytes total
0100h-(heap_base-1) | .LIB image + BSS
Code + DCC runtime + initialized data + BSS
heap_base-C5FFh | malloc heap
512-byte stack example; heap size depends on image + BSS
C600h-C7FFh | Call stack (512-byte example)
Grows down; .LIB stack budget: 256-2,048 bytes
C800h-DDFFh | Separate general pool
5,632 bytes | checked handles | not the DCC malloc heap
DE00h-E5FFh | Resident service workspace
BDOS proxy, library loader, exports and service stacks
E600h-EDFFh | Resident extent allocator
Allocation metadata, dispatch and context management
E600h-EDFFh | CCP
Console Command Processor: prompt and .COM loading
EE00h-FB3Fh | BDOS shim / tables
Entry EE06h | private stack F600h-F7FFh
EE00h-FB3Fh | Authoritative CP/M BDOS
Files, directories and shared drive allocation state
FB40h-FB7Fh | Mirrored trampoline
Warm-boot return and checked extent lookup
FB40h-FB7Fh | Mirrored trampoline
Matching code at the same addresses
FB80h-FEFFh | BIOS buffer, core and padding
FC00h: standard 17-entry BIOS jump table
FB80h-FEFFh | BIOS buffer, core and padding
Record and console I/O available to bank-1 BDOS
FF00h-FFFFh | Mirrored bank-switch gateway
READ / WRITE / INFO / service + private workspace
FF00h-FFFFh | Mirrored bank-switch gateway
Matching instructions survive the A16 switch
A bank switch is a controlled call, not a pointer conversion
1. Save caller state; copy checked arguments through the mirrored gateway.
2. OUT 07h selects bank 1 in PIO1; resident code runs with a bank-1 service or library stack.
3. Restore bank 0 and the caller's stack; copy results back. No nested calls or cross-bank pointers.
BSS (Block Started by Symbol): zero-initialized global and static variables
For a bank-1 library, the loader clears BSS to zero before execution.
Example: static unsigned char buffer[1024]; uses 1,024 BSS bytes, without storing those zeros in the .LIB file.
Image = code + DCC runtime + initialized data | malloc heap = dynamic allocations | call stack = call state + locals
heap_base is the first address after the image and BSS.
Source-backed overview: cpm-execution.md, build_images.py, bank0_bdos_shim.asm and banked_transfer.asm
